findings.summary: Xoxoday sync never upserts fetched products
findings.details: `runSync()` fetches the provider catalog, derives the provider IDs, and only deactivates currently active NON_CASH items that are missing from the response. There is no create/update path for products returned by Xoxoday, so an initial sync with a valid non-empty response and an empty local catalog will end in `SUCCESS` while importing zero redemption items. That makes the integration health lie and leaves admins with no provider-backed catalog to configure.
findings.recommendation: During sync, upsert each `XoxodayProductResponse` into `redemption_catalog_items` keyed by `(category, provider_item_id)`, update metadata/active state/last_synced_at, and only mark sync successful after persisted counts are validated and logged.

findings.summary: Budget utilization uniqueness adds a race to the claim path
findings.details: The migration adds unique indexes for `(incentive_id, currency_id[, location_value_id])`, but `ClaimService.applyBudgetCap()` still does the old `find...ForUpdate().orElseGet(save(...))` sequence. When two first claims for the same incentive/currency hit an empty utilization key concurrently, neither query can lock a missing row and both can try to insert; after V9 one transaction will hit a unique violation instead of awarding cleanly. The hardened `ensureExists()` path exists in `RewardGrantService`, but this claim path still bypasses it.
findings.recommendation: Route claim rewards through `RewardGrantService` or change this method to call `budgetUtilizationRepository.ensureExists(...)` before the `FOR UPDATE` read, then load the row and retry/translate unique conflicts explicitly.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
